principles.statement: Each surface has one customer job. New units compose into existing surfaces instead of stacking chrome.
Plain type, generous space, no decorative gamification.
Kid-facing strings live in packs and datasets so languages can swap without kernel edits.
No account. Memory stays on this device.
A registered unit is not shipped until an existing journey selects it in the production mix.
Core loop uses browser APIs and local storage. No paid cloud required.
